Amazing!!!!
Nov 2016 • Couples
We visited the Zen Rooftop Lounge for my birthday and it was amazing. If you ever visit Da Nang, this restaurant must be on your list to visit! The Zen Rooftop Lounge is on the 22nd floor offering amazing views of the coastline and city. The staff was over accommodating and incredibly polite. Our waiter, Long, was so friendly and able to provide us tourism ideas about Da Nang while serving our food. The food was out of this world. The entire menu looked delicious but we order the prawns appetizer, pumpkin soup, lamb shanks, and salmon. The plating was beautiful and the food melted on your mouth. The best food!! The ambience was pure "Zen" with stunning views and cool color schemes. Highly recommend this place to everyone! Thank you Long for making my birthday celebration so special!
